entities.name: King Lucard
entities.description: Vampire king of the island of Luneau on Ixalan, weary and fragile; his fate is uncertain.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who enacted a plan to escape by transforming a spider and summoning the monstrosaur's spirit.

entities.name: Marcois Jean-Jaquent
entities.description: Baron of Vernot who cruelly vivisected the monstrosaur.

entities.name: Monstrosaur
entities.description: Creature vivisected by the baron and revived by Vivien in a rampage.

events.summary: Vivien enlarges a spider to cause panic and summons the spirit of the monstrosaur, which wreaks havoc in the ballroom.
events.quote: Vivien used her magic to transform a small spider into a giant

events.summary: The ballroom collapses and King Lucard's fate is left uncertain.
events.quote: The precise fate of King Lucard is not detailed
